links.outcome: AI calculator versus four MSK radiologists on ST-RADS sensitivity and specificity
links.effect: Sensitivity similar (85% radiologists, 86% image-only, 81% text-only, 86% combined). Specificity 76.5% radiologists vs 69.4% text-only (p=0.46), 61.2% combined, 25.5% image-only.
links.quote: Text features-only did not differ significantly from radiologists (p = 0.46).

screen.reason: Empirical study testing an AI-based web tool (using GPT API) for ST-RADS scoring, comparing multiple input modes (image-only vs text-only vs multimodal) against expert radiologists on retrospective cases.

primary.practice: comparing input modalities (image-only vs text-only vs multimodal) for diagnostic calculator
